name: Steps
description: A plan or timeline as numbered steps or a timeline with when-labels; each marker comes from the brand through a slot.
whenToUse: A sequence in time: a pilot plan, a rollout, a decision process. Two to six steps with a short title and body; 'timeline' when each has a when-label (weeks, quarters). The marker beside each step comes through the stepMarker slot. NOT for parallel ideas (Narrative).
